title: Ford ATF Adapter
lead: A new transmission adapter for Ford 10-speed transmissions.
body: Smaller vehicles such as the Ranger and Explorer need this adapter: the space around the cooler is too tight to reach the line pressure port. The adapter bolts directly to the transmission with the same bolt that attaches the cooler, for a quick, reliable transmission fluid exchange.
parts: Ranger, Explorer and other Ford 10-speed applications
source: New Ford ATF Adapter Vol. 23 No. 1.pdf
